name: Rainfed Area Development (RAD)
hard_exclusions: individual eligibility alone does not guarantee scheme rollout; village/cluster eligibility matters
questions: Is your farm in a rainfed area, and are you looking for an integrated farming setup?
temporal_note: Cluster/project approval is material to access.

source_text_aliases: [EXCLUSION] individual eligibility alone does not guarantee scheme rollout; village/cluster eligibility matters

description.en: Implementation depends on an approved village cluster or project and must be confirmed separately.
description.or: କାର୍ଯ୍ୟାନ୍ୱୟନ ଅନୁମୋଦିତ ଗ୍ରାମ କ୍ଲଷ୍ଟର କିମ୍ବା ପ୍ରକଳ୍ପ ଉପରେ ନିର୍ଭର କରେ ଏବଂ ଅଲଗା ଭାବେ ଯାଞ୍ଚ ହେବା ଦରକାର।

description.en: The source generally describes clusters of 100 hectares or more; this is a project-level condition, not the citizen's land threshold.
description.or: ଉତ୍ସରେ ସାଧାରଣତଃ ୧୦୦ ହେକ୍ଟର କିମ୍ବା ଅଧିକ କ୍ଲଷ୍ଟର ବର୍ଣ୍ଣିତ; ଏହା ପ୍ରକଳ୍ପ ସ୍ତରର ସର୍ତ୍ତ, ନାଗରିକଙ୍କ ଜମି ସୀମା ନୁହେଁ।
